objects.name: Analytic 2256
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies Secure Shell (SSH), web application, or Industrial Control System (ICS) Application Programming Interface (API) authentication attempts on ICS Linux servers from internet-sourced Internet Protocol (IP) addresses. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the asset's documented role does not permit the connection and the destination/proxy/service is outside the approved communications profile, with process/service identity used as corroboration where available. Suppress approved vendor support, update repositories, remote operations, failover paths, and documented temporary connectivity.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: syslog:auth
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: authentication attempt or success from internet-sourced Internet Protocol (IP) address not in organizational IP space
